packs.name: Meadow
packs.blurb: Hop from tile to tile and visit each one once.

packs.name: Creek
packs.blurb: Jump over a missing tile. Gold tiles need two visits.

packs.name: Gully
packs.blurb: Steel tiles hold on for three visits.

packs.name: Outcrop
packs.blurb: Gold and steel tiles share the board.

packs.name: Billabong
packs.blurb: Signpost tiles can only be left the way they point.

packs.name: Ridge
packs.blurb: Signposts and metals, gold on one level and steel on the next.

packs.name: Mesa
packs.blurb: Gate tiles can only be entered from one side.

packs.name: Gorge
packs.blurb: Gates and metals, gold on one level and steel on the next.

packs.name: Plateau
packs.blurb: Gold, steel and gate tiles, all together.

packs.name: Outback
packs.blurb: The biggest board, with every tile kind in the game together.
